title: Eurostat SDG 11.52 – Premature deaths due to exposure to PM2.5, Italy (annual, national)
summary: Eurostat JSON-stat table sdg_11_52 with a single geography (IT), a single pollutant (PM2.5) and a single effect (premature death), reported annually in two units (number and rate). It is national context for N6 only: it gives no hourly, district, station or traffic data. The API returned 36 cells across 18 years (2005–2023) with no missing values, though the warning TIME_GAPS applies to the year series.

quality_notes: Coverage vs needs: the table is annual and national (IT). It cannot meet N1–N3, N4 or N5 (hourly, daily, district or event grain). It only partly touches N6 (annual national context).
Prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) overlaps only 2005 in this table, so it gives at most one year of context for that window.
Production window (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) is not covered: the last year in the table is 2023 and the table was updated 2025-12-09.
TIME_GAPS warning: the time dimension lists 2005 and 2007–2023; 2006 is absent (18 years, not 19).
Rate unit (RT) denominator is not stated in the summary; Number and Rate values should not be compared without the documentation.
Licence not established: no licence text found at the source; Eurostat copyright page was not readable (login redirect).
